sources.entry: Papers we love: papers from the computer science community to read and discuss. Can be a good source of inspiration of solving your design problems.

summary.one_liner: Papers We Love is a community repository that directories notable academic computer science papers, linking to where they can be found, and supports local reading meetups.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a community around reading and discussing academic computer science papers, with this repository acting as a directory of papers the community has gathered from across the web. Because of licensing, the papers are not always hosted directly; the README says hosted papers are marked with a scroll emoji in the directory, and otherwise only links are provided. It points to local chapter meetups and a Discord server for discussion, and a YouTube channel of past presentations. The README also includes a long list of other places to find papers, plus guidance on how to read research papers. It mentions a download script (scripts/download.sh) that scrapes markdown files for PDF links and downloads them into directories.
use_cases: find well-regarded computer science papers to read
join a local paper reading group or meetup
discuss research papers with a community
look up papers for design inspiration
learn how to read academic papers
bulk download PDFs linked in a paper directory
notable: Directory of computer science papers that links to sources across the web
Local chapter meetups and a Discord server for discussion
Download script that scrapes markdown for PDF links and fetches papers
Curated list of other paper sources and guides on reading research papers
caveats: Papers are often not hosted due to licensing; only links are provided for many entries
The README points to a separate CONTRIBUTING.md and wiki rather than detailing full options; download script usage beyond the basic command is referenced but not shown
